name: Early Click Buffer
description: Registers clicks made up to 20 frames early and shows how many frames it saved you.

window-frames.name: Buffer Window (frames)
window-frames.description: How many frames early a click can be and still register. 0 = off, max 20.

show-indicator.name: Show Saved Frames
show-indicator.description: Shows how many frames the mod saved you on each buffered click.
